**Audited head:** `030194383bffda641fa9a0e578efd496e92767bb`  
**Base:** `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd`  
**Audit time:** `2026-07-31T08:30:20Z`  
**Disposition:** leave **OPEN + DRAFT**. **NO APPROVAL. NO PROMOTION. NO MERGE.**

The gap disposition is directionally honest, but it is no longer internally sound as written: an exact live CMON-hosted final rulebook is available now, and the current CMON `Rules & More` surface identifies that rulebook. Bathcat can repair this on the same PR. The governing denominator must nevertheless remain `OPEN / UNKNOWN` because complete rule-bearing card text and a closed global FAQ/errata/clarification inventory are still unproved.

No official FAQ, errata, or clarification attachment was independently located. That is a search result, not proof of universal absence.

## Recomputed arithmetic and governing denominator

- Current CMON manifest has exactly seven physical categories: `87 cards + 5 Hunter Boards + 5 Hunter Health Dials + 75 Blood Echo plastic tokens + 16 cardboard tokens + 3 custom Monster dice + 1 rulebook`; category transcription is **`7 / 7 = 100%`**.
- Official rulebook p. 4 independently gives `25 Hunter Starter + 32 Hunter Upgrade + 5 Final Boss + 18 Chalice Dungeon Monster + 7 Chalice Dungeon Boss = 87`; physical card-class allocation is **`87 / 87 = 100%`**.
- Token reconciliations also hold: `15 value-5 + 60 value-1 = 75` Blood Echoes; `15 Trophy + 1 First Player = 16` cardboard tokens.
- No expansion leakage was found in that arithmetic. Runes and Death Tokens occur only in explicit Hunter's Nightmare exclusions/reception context.
- Those two 100% figures are bounded inventory/allocation metrics, **not card-identity/text coverage and not governing-rules completeness**.
- Governing authority remains **OPEN / UNKNOWN**. The official rulebook is now closed and available, but complete local text is still missing for all five rule-bearing card classes: Starter Actions, Upgrades, Monsters, Chalice Bosses, and Final Bosses. A closed publisher-wide FAQ/errata/clarification index is also unproved.
- The governing ledger should additionally classify the **Hunter Board/player aid** (round sequence, trophy/scoring tracks, printed Blood Echo zones/bonuses) and **three Monster dice** (damage/combo resolving faces) as rule-bearing component classes, then state whether the official rulebook fully governs each. Dials and tokens appear to be state/value markers rather than independent resolving-text authorities. Their omission from the current ledger makes its class enumeration incomplete even though the five card-class blocker is correctly recognized.

## Representative claim, reception, and visual findings

- Rulebook spot checks support the changed setup, secret/simultaneous action choice and nonbinding promises, transform timing, Instant timing, monster damage/combo chain, immediate death, First Player attack allocation, boss persistence, Dream/death/banking, upgrades and seven-card cap, trophies/Final Boss, scaling, scoring, and two-stage tie rule. The hand-development/action-retrieval description is accurate; this is not a conventional personal draw/reshuffle deck-building loop.
- All 13 target OKFs are `needs_followup`. Read-only probe found 67 body claims, each with a complete Source/Evidence/Confidence triplet and no undeclared source IDs. All eleven index links resolve. Generated index correctly changes Bloodborne to `needs_followup:13`; telemetry adds only the declared generator/validator rows.
- Reception is base-game scoped and representative: Ars supports bluffing/betrayal/dread/take-that and easy learning; RPGFan supports planning/prediction, luck, upgrade-reveal friction, and limited content; Meeple Mountain supports five-player briskness, burst-die tension, the 32-card/five-boss content complaint, and drab/rendered presentation. Expansion text is kept as an explicit boundary rather than imported as base rules.
- Local visual hashes match the manifest: contact sheet `01e4a371...a036`; references `f09aa9ad...4262`, `eeae3e6d...2019`, `58774eb0...8e62`, `f8080501...13f2`. The four panels are distinct, uncorrupted, materially reduced, analytically useful (layout; encounter anatomy; Action/Upgrade anatomy; board/trophy relationships), not a complete component substitute, and show no Rune/Death Token/Hunter's Nightmare leakage.
- Visual source receipt drift needs disclosure. The four same official URLs currently return Cloudflare-polished PNGs with hashes `97fbd759...1237`, `5fcf12b7...ad61`, `27345a7f...19b4`, `88dd0387...19c2` and bytes `537,772`, `375,927`, `417,867`, `443,750`. Response headers report `cf-polished: ok` and `orig_size` values exactly matching the PR's `659,031`, `422,512`, `2,684,174`, `2,726,821`. The PR currently presents the origin hashes as directly reproducible HTTP receipts without recording this transformation/drift distinction.

## Required repair matrix

1. **Replace the provisional rulebook authority.** Register the exact live CMON S3 URL above as the official 2016 rulebook; record its current status/type/bytes/pages/hash/metadata. Retain the 1j1ju copy only as a mirror derivative if useful, clearly subordinate to the official object.
2. **Correct every stale gap statement.** Remove claims that no CMON-hosted final rulebook was retrieved and that current `Rules & More` exposes no rulebook. Record that it currently exposes `Rulebook 79.01 MB`; do not overclaim that this proves no FAQ/errata exists elsewhere.
3. **Recompute the governing ledger, without fabricating a percentage.** Close the official-rulebook row; add explicit disposition for Hunter Boards/player aid and Monster dice; keep the five card-text classes and the closed-support-index question open. Keep distinct card identity/text coverage `UNKNOWN` and do not create a composite score.
4. **Refresh source receipts and claim confidence.** Rebind rule claims to the official rulebook source. Update current product-page/proxy receipt. Preserve dynamic-review hash drift as dated observations rather than immutable expectations.
5. **Repair visual provenance receipts.** Distinguish raw-origin hash/size from the currently served Cloudflare-polished representation, record both where useful, and state which bytes actually produced each derivative/contact sheet. Rebuild only if required to make derivation reproducible; preserve the bounded editorial-excerpt policy.
6. Run the normal final ordered generator/validator pass once, commit/push the same branch, verify exact-head CI, and request a wholly fresh Mennonite audit. Do not mark ready.

## Risk record / stop condition

- **Assumption:** the draft can still say official rulebook provenance is unproved.
- **Failure:** the ledger misstates a currently retrievable governing authority and overstates the residual help required from T.
- **Evidence:** live CMON S3 object plus current CMON `Rules & More` text above.
- **Cheapest test:** retrieve the exact S3 URL and compare page count/text/component spread against the mirror; completed.
- **Mitigation:** apply the repair matrix while preserving the open card/support denominator.
- **Abort condition:** any head/base drift, any attempt to convert inventory arithmetic into governing completeness, or any expansion/card text imported without an immutable scoped source.

**Conversion evidence:** a repaired exact head with the official rulebook correctly registered, stale negative claims removed, expanded authority-class ledger, reproducible visual receipts, complete card-local corpus/support closure if later available, and exact-head green CI. Until a fresh independent audit of that head: **REVISE; OPEN + DRAFT; NO APPROVAL; NO MERGE.**

1. a complete immutable English-2016 base-game card-local corpus for Starter Actions, Upgrades, Monsters, Chalice Dungeon Bosses, and Final Bosses;
2. a closed official FAQ/errata/clarification/support inventory, or authoritative evidence that no such material exists; and
